shared_tail.surface: أبي بكر بن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث بن هشام

notes: Two isnads: the first ends at Malik before «ح»; the second, after «ح», names Malik and then the names written once below
«عن عائشة، وأم سلمة» are the two Companions who said it together: one level of co-transmitters
«قال عبد الله الأذرمي في حديثه» is his wording variant, left out; «قال أبو داود» is the compiler's comment
